symptom: ako/mxcli#1822 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1683): an OpenCode session in an `init --tool opencode` project started with 150 instruction files, 2.7 MB (~73% of a 1M window); .opencode/skills/ copies were described by their title ('Agents') instead of the skill's 'Use when…' description.
cause: generateOpenCodeConfig listed .opencode/skills/**/SKILL.md and .ai-context/skills/*/SKILL.md as `instructions`, which OpenCode inlines; wrapSkillContent prepended a second frontmatter described by the first heading in front of the skill's own, and OpenCode reads the first.
insight: A tool adapter written before the Agent Skills migration (#906/#959) kept the force-feed pattern that migration removed; when skills change shape, re-check every per-tool wrapper, which each have their own copy of the old assumption (Vibe's wrapper still reads the heading).
